embeds.title: Welcome to Venice
embeds.description:
Venice is a precision shot-timing companion for NBA 2K27 on PS5. This is the only Start Here channel—read it, then verify below.

**1. Verify** with the button below.
**2. Try it free:** a 7-day trial, no card — claim it at zaeorion.com or run `/claim_trial`.
**3. Install:** once Trial or Customer access is granted, open <#1549499799861067876> and unlock the app with a one-time code from zaeorion.com/connect.
**4. Membership:** the only paid plan is **$19.99/month** at zaeorion.com, linked to your Discord account.

**Venice is in beta.** PS5 with a capture card is the supported setup; Remote Play-only and Xbox are experimental and may not work on your rig yet.

embeds.title: Rules of the server
embeds.description:
**Respect members and staff.** No harassment, hate, threats, scams, or unsolicited DMs.
**No spam or self-promotion.** Do not flood messages, mass-mention, post invite links, or use alts/bots to evade moderation.
**Keep access personal.** Do not share, sell, leak, or transfer accounts or one-time connect codes, and do not redistribute the app, its installer, or its files.
**Use private support.** Purchase and account questions belong in <#1549499767321534464>; never post codes, passwords, or payment data publicly.
**Report beta problems in a ticket.** Venice is in beta. Bugs, crashes, and timing problems belong in a ticket with your log attached — public channels cannot action them.
**Follow Discord's rules.** Moderation actions are recorded and may be appealed through a ticket.

embeds.title: Terms, trial, and checkout
embeds.description:
The 7-day trial is **one per Discord account and one per PC**. No card is needed. Access is linked to your Discord account — there is no licence key — and it unlocks one PC at a time through zaeorion.com/connect. Use `/hwid_reset` to move PCs: the first **3 resets are free**, after that each reset takes one day off an eligible subscription.

Venice is in **beta**: PS5 with a capture card is the supported setup, and Remote Play-only and Xbox are experimental. The monthly plan is **$19.99/month** and renews until you cancel. Cancel any time in the billing portal: https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/5kQ7sL0Ec4Ya5MfcFsgQE00 — you keep access to the end of the period you have already paid for. To buy, sign in with Discord at zaeorion.com and stay a member of this server. Full terms: https://zaeorion.com/terms.html · refunds: https://zaeorion.com/refunds.html · privacy: https://zaeorion.com/privacy.html.
Questions? Open <#1549499767321534464>.
